text:
Sarah Cheng: @naomi quick heads-up — candidate for Backend IC4 has a timezone conflict, can we swap one panelist? Panel scheduled Mon 10am PST. I can cover but I'd like to confirm debrief roles and rubric expectations (esp. system design vs coding weighting).
Naomi (People Ops): Thanks Sarah :wave: What's the candidate's current panel? can you paste the lineup?
Sarah Cheng: Current: Mohit, Jared, Sarah. Jared is in GMT+1 and has a conflict. Mohit can still join. If Jared can't, would prefer Emily to replace him.
Mohit Kumar: I can stay. Emily, can you cover Mon 10am PST? that's 6pm CET for you.
Emily Park: I can do 6pm CET but prefer to swap with Tues slot if it's possible. Otherwise I can take Mon.
Jared Lewis: Hey team, sorry — client call moved. I can do a hard swap with Tues 3pm PST if that helps.
Naomi (People Ops): We can do a swap. Two quick logistics Qs: 1) who will own the debrief note? 2) our rubric uses 1-4 scale; Sarah, can you confirm alignment on how to score 'problem decomposition' vs 'implementation'? 
Sarah Cheng: I can write the debrief. For rubric: score 1-4; give separate ticks for 'clarity of approach' and 'edge-case handling'. For system-design questions, weight is 60% design 40% coding. For coding prompts, focus on correctness then style.
Jared Lewis: Sounds good. Also suggest we add a short 'risk note' if candidate needed heavy prompting.
Naomi (People Ops): Noted. I'll update the panel invite: replace Jared with Emily for Mon or swap candidate to Tues — Sarah, Mohit, Emily. I'll send updated calendar + Prep packet.
People-ops-bot: Calendar updated: panel members changed — invite resent.
Sarah Cheng: :thumbsup: thanks all. I'll draft the debrief template and post it in #interviews later today.
Emily Park: Got it. I'll review the rubric doc before the panel.
Mohit Kumar: I'll join and take notes.
Naomi (People Ops): Closing loop — invite sent with Emily. Last check: Sarah will take debrief, Mohit note-taker, Jared fallback if needed. If anything changes ping me. :white_check_mark:
